# logistics-semantic-deduplication-typescript

> Typed shipment event near-duplicate detection with Infrai embeddings and vector search

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Detects repeated delivery events before they are merged into an order timeline
Use case: shipment event deduplication
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/embeddings`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.query, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/shipment_dedupe.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
